Navitus Health Solutions is seeking an Analytics Engineer to join our team!

The Analytics Engineer ensures efforts are in alignment with the Analytics team to support customer-focused objectives and the IT Vision, a collaborative partner delivering innovative ideas, solutions and services to simplify people’s lives. The Analytics Engineer will be responsible for designing streaming capabilities for the internal and external movement of data to support our clients’ needs. The ideal candidate is experienced in Domain driven development and event driven architecture with real time data transformations. Additionally, the ideal candidate is passionate about partnering with business stakeholders to translate data into actionable insights that drive decision-making. Job Summary

This role serves as the primary data product expert, leading the design, development, and implementation of scalable data solutions. The Lead Data Product Analyst collaborates closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and architects to align data products with strategic objectives. This role requires a strong blend of business acumen, technical expertise, and leadership to drive data adoption and maximize business value. As a key liaison, the Lead Data Product Analyst ensures that business partners can effectively access, interpret, and utilize data to drive decision-making and operational efficiency.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Conduct independent research on all aspects of a product’s experiences and data, provide findings and recommendations on which data are critical to fully understand the customer experience.

Own and drive the data product lifecycle, from ideation to deployment, ensuring alignment with business goals.

Lead cross-functional collaborations between business leaders, data engineers, data scientists, and software developers to enhance data accessibility and usability.

Develop and refine data models, tables, and dashboards to support self-service analytics and business intelligence initiatives.

Define and implement best practices for data governance, integrity, and quality assurance across data products.

Act as a thought leader and subject matter expert, advocating for data-driven decision-making and fostering a culture of data literacy.

Partner with business teams to translate strategic goals into actionable data solutions that support revenue growth, operational efficiency, and customer insights.

Develop and maintain documentation, training materials, and guidance for data product usage across the organization.

Mentor junior analysts and contribute to team skill development through training and coaching.

Evaluate and integrate new data sources and technologies that enhance analytics capabilities.

Comply with health and safety guidelines and rules; managers should also ensure compliance across their teams.

Protect Chamberlain Group’s reputation by keeping information confidential.

Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reading professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies.

Contribute to the team effort by accomplishing related results and participating on projects as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

Education/Certifications:

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or another related field

Experience:

8+ years of experience in analytics, data product management, or business intelligence.

5+ years of experience in a business analysis role, working with data solutions that impact business strategy.

3+ years of experience leading data-driven projects and cross-functional teams.

Expertise in data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik) and proficiency in SQL, Python, or equivalent analytical tools.

Experience with cloud-based data environments such as Azure, AWS, or Databricks.

Strong background in designing and implementing data models, ETL processes, and self-service analytics solutions.

Proven ability to drive the adoption of data products and facilitate alignment between business and technical teams.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Strong proficiency in SQL.

Strong understanding of data warehouse/data modeling concepts and procedures.

Ability to lead complex projects, manage stakeholder expectations, and drive alignment across diverse teams.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to synthesize large datasets into actionable insights.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Deep understanding of business processes and how data can drive efficiencies and competitive advantages.

Hands-on experience with data modeling, governance, and automation of analytics workflows.

Passion for mentoring and fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.

Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while collaborating with multiple teams.

Ability to develop, document, and deliver end user materials such as training or project SDLC artifacts.

Working knowledge of Azure cloud-based architecture and PowerBI.

Proficiency within the Microsoft Office Suite of products.

JOIN US ON OUR MISSION TO BECOME THE #1 RETAIL TRADING PLATFORM IN THE WORLD

Welcome to the dynamic world of NinjaTrader! As an industry-leading trading platform and futures broker, we're on a mission to empower traders to take control of their financial destiny. How do we do it? We provide cutting-edge products and services that enhance the trading journey. Whether a seasoned pro or just starting out, NinjaTrader equips traders with award-winning software and brokerage services to navigate the world's leading financial markets with confidence.

Our growth story is nothing short of exhilarating. Over the last 20 years, NinjaTrader has been dedicated to understanding and supporting traders on their journey toward trading triumph. In the last five years alone, our user base has grown by 400% to over 1.9 million users and we have become the number one rated futures brokerage worldwide.

But we're not stopping there. We're constantly evolving, pushing boundaries, and modernizing the futures industry. Our commitment to innovation means users will always have access to dynamic tools, real-time support, and a community of like-minded traders.

So, why work at NinjaTrader? Here, you're not just part of a team; you're part of a movement. We empower employees to reach new heights in their careers by providing a dynamic culture focused on social connection, professional development, and employee recognition initiatives. Sounds too good to be true? Take it from our employees.

Join us as we redefine what's possible in trading, advocate for our customers, and continue our journey toward becoming the world's top retail-focused trading platform in the world.

What you'll do:

This is a rare opportunity for a growth-minded individual to not only join a fast-growing organization but help set up its data culture. As Manager of Data and Analytics, you will work closely with internal business partners across the organization on reporting and analysis tasks.

In this role you will:

Develop scalable and automated reporting and analytics solutions and performance monitoring tools for the end user
Analyze performance, identify trends from data, find new opportunities and address ad-hoc data requests
Build and maintain cross-functional partnerships directly with key stakeholders across engineering, product, finance, sales and marketing
Evangelize and facilitate the use of data, including standardized KPIs and consistent measurement methodologies
Present project ideas and results to multiple levels of leadership with effective presentation and visualization
Utilize modern data tools such as dbt and Looker to clean and organize data

What you'll need:

Technical degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field
5+ years' experience in data analysis, data science, statistics, or related field
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to understand, translate, and map business questions into analysis tasks and projects
Ability to work independently while interacting with multiple business teams and stakeholders
Experience training end-users on new reports and dashboards
Expertise in SQL, PowerBI, Snowflake, or similar technologies
Experience with statistical analysis, regression modeling and forecasting, and time series analysis

Bonus points for:

Understanding of data warehousing technologies
Experience in financial services is a strong plus, including financial and compliance related reporting

Compensation:

The salary for this role starts at $90,000 USD. In addition, this position will also receive an annual target bonus of 8%. Bonus pay at NinjaTrader is based on individual performance (50%) as well as company/team performance (50%).

Salary and bonus earnings are only two components of the total compensation package offered by NinjaTrader. NinjaTrader offers a 401K plan through ADP under which the company will match up to 3.5% of employee contributions. Annual paid time off allowance accrues at a rate of 18 days per year (some positions may qualify for more) plus seven paid holidays.

This role is based in Chicago, IL. We are not open to remote candidates for this role.

For Chicago-based employees, we follow a hybrid work schedule: In-office Tuesday through Thursday, with remote work on Mondays and Fridays. In addition to these weekly remote days, we offer:
